class ChatInput(ChatNode):
    display_name = "Chat Input"
    description = "Get chat inputs from the Playground."
    icon = "MessagesSquare"
    name = "ChatInput"
    minimized = True

    inputs = [
        MultilineInput(
            name="input_value",
            display_name="Input Text",
            value="",
            info="Message to be passed as input.",
            input_types=[],
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="should_store_message",
            display_name="Store Messages",
            info="Store the message in the history.",
            value=True,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="sender",
            display_name="Sender Type",
            options=[MESSAGE_SENDER_AI, MESSAGE_SENDER_USER],
            value=MESSAGE_SENDER_USER,
            info="Type of sender.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="sender_name",
            display_name="Sender Name",
            info="Name of the sender.",
            value=MESSAGE_SENDER_NAME_USER,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="session_id",
            display_name="Session ID",
            info="The session ID of the chat. If empty, the current session ID parameter will be used.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        FileInput(
            name="files",
            display_name="Files",
            file_types=TEXT_FILE_TYPES + IMG_FILE_TYPES,
            info="Files to be sent with the message.",
            advanced=True,
            is_list=True,
            temp_file=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="background_color",
            display_name="Background Color",
            info="The background color of the icon.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="chat_icon",
            display_name="Icon",
            info="The icon of the message.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="text_color",
            display_name="Text Color",
            info="The text color of the name",
            advanced=True,
        ),
    ]
    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Chat Message", name="message", method="message_response"),
    ]

    async def message_response(self) -> Message:
        from loguru import logger

        background_color = self.background_color
        text_color = self.text_color
        icon = self.chat_icon

        message = await Message.create(
            text=self.input_value,
            sender=self.sender,
            sender_name=self.sender_name,
            session_id=self.session_id,
            files=self.files,
            properties={
                "background_color": background_color,
                "text_color": text_color,
                "icon": icon,
            },
        )
        if self.session_id and isinstance(message, Message) and self.should_store_message:
            stored_message = await self.send_message(
                message,
            )
            self.message.value = stored_message
            message = stored_message

        # Pre-fetch image data from storage (Azure/local) so that
        # downstream to_lc_message() can build multimodal content synchronously.
        # Must happen AFTER store, because send_message returns a new Message
        # object that doesn't carry the _base64_cache from the original.
        if isinstance(message, Message):
            await message.resolve_images()

        # Add log for user message
        if message.sender == MESSAGE_SENDER_USER:
            logger.info(f"[USER_MESSAGE] User: {message.text}")
        self.status = message
        return message

"""Document intelligence step: extract and normalise fields from the attachments.

Deterministic, evidence-backed extraction (document, page, confidence) for the
structured synthetic documents, optionally refined by an LLM for free-form
layouts. The output is the standard underwriting data model used by the
validation, rating and quote steps.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
from datetime import date, datetime

from agentcore.custom.custom_node.node import Node
from agentcore.io import BoolInput, DataInput, HandleInput, Output
from agentcore.schema.data import Data

# Field label patterns -> (field name, document type where it is authoritative)
FIELD_PATTERNS: dict[str, tuple[str, str]] = {
    "company_name": (r"Company Name\s*:\s*(.+)", "application"),
    "industry": (r"Industry\s*:\s*(.+)", "application"),
    "registered_address": (r"Registered Address\s*:\s*(.+)", "application"),
    "application_total_employees": (r"Total Employees\s*:\s*([\d,]+)", "application"),
    "requested_sum_insured": (r"Requested Sum Insured per Employee\s*:\s*(?:INR|Rs\.?|₹)?\s*([\d,]+)", "application"),
    "policy_type": (r"Policy Type\s*:\s*(.+)", "application"),
    "coverage_start_date": (r"Coverage Start Date\s*:\s*([\d-]+)", "application"),
    "broker_name": (r"Broker\s*:\s*(.+)", "application"),
    "broker_email": (r"Contact Email\s*:\s*(\S+@\S+)", "application"),
    "census_date": (r"Census Date\s*:\s*([\d-]+)", "census"),
    "census_total_employees": (r"Total Employees in Census\s*:\s*([\d,]+)", "census"),
    "claims_policy_period": (r"Policy Period\s*:\s*(.+)", "claims"),
    "claims_total_summary": (r"Total Incurred Claims \(Summary\)\s*:\s*(?:INR|Rs\.?|₹)?\s*([\d,]+)", "claims"),
    "claims_total_detailed": (r"Total of Detailed Claims\s*:\s*(?:INR|Rs\.?|₹)?\s*([\d,]+)", "claims"),
    "current_insurer": (r"Insurer\s*:\s*(.+)", "policy"),
    "policy_number": (r"Policy Number\s*:\s*(\S+)", "policy"),
    "policy_start_date": (r"Policy Start Date\s*:\s*([\d-]+)", "policy"),
    "policy_expiry_date": (r"Policy Expiry Date\s*:\s*([\d-]+)", "policy"),
    "current_sum_insured": (r"Sum Insured per Employee\s*:\s*(?:INR|Rs\.?|₹)?\s*([\d,]+)", "policy"),
    "current_annual_premium": (r"Annual Premium \(Current\)\s*:\s*(?:INR|Rs\.?|₹)?\s*([\d,]+)", "policy"),
}
NUMERIC_FIELDS = {
    "application_total_employees",
    "requested_sum_insured",
    "census_total_employees",
    "claims_total_summary",
    "claims_total_detailed",
    "current_sum_insured",
    "current_annual_premium",
}
CENSUS_ROW = re.compile(
    r"(EMP\d+)\s*\|\s*(.+?)\s*\|\s*DOB\s*([\d-]+)\s*\|\s*Age\s*(\d+)\s*\|\s*(.+?)\s*\|\s*Dependants\s*(\d+)",
    re.I,
)
CLAIM_ROW = re.compile(r"(CLM-\d+)\s*\|\s*([\d-]+)\s*\|\s*(EMP\d+)\s*\|\s*(.+?)\s*\|\s*(?:INR|Rs\.?|₹)?\s*([\d,]+)", re.I)


def _to_int(value: str) -> int | None:
    try:
        return int(str(value).replace(",", "").strip())
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return None


class UnderwritingDocumentExtractor(Node):
    display_name = "2. Document Intelligence & Normalisation"
    description = (
        "Extracts fields from every attachment with source document, page and confidence, parses the census and "
        "claims tables and consolidates everything into the standard underwriting data model."
    )
    icon = "scan-text"
    name = "UnderwritingDocumentExtractor"

    inputs = [
        DataInput(name="case", display_name="Underwriting Case", info="Output of the intake step.", required=True),
        HandleInput(
            name="llm",
            display_name="Language Model (optional)",
            info="Optional LLM used to extract fields the rule-based extractor could not find in free-form documents.",
            input_types=["LanguageModel"],
            required=False,
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="use_llm_for_missing",
            display_name="Use LLM for missing fields",
            value=True,
            info="When a model is connected, ask it only for fields the deterministic extractor left empty.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
    ]

    outputs = [Output(display_name="Extracted Case", name="extracted", method="extract")]

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ helpers
    @staticmethod
    def _age_on(dob: str, as_of: date) -> int | None:
        try:
            d = datetime.strptime(dob, "%Y-%m-%d").date()
        except ValueError:
            return None
        return as_of.year - d.year - ((as_of.month, as_of.day) < (d.month, d.day))

    def _llm_fill(self, missing: list[str], documents: list[dict]) -> dict:
        if not missing or self.llm is None:
            return {}
        corpus = "\n\n".join(f"### {d['name']} (page {p['page']})\n{p['text'][:3000]}" for d in documents for p in d["pages"])
        prompt = (
            "You are an insurance underwriting assistant. Extract ONLY the following fields from the documents. "
            "Return strict JSON: {field: {\"value\": <string>, \"source_doc\": <file name>, \"page\": <int>}}. "
            "Use null when a field is genuinely absent. Do not invent values.\n\n"
            f"Fields: {', '.join(missing)}\n\nDocuments:\n{corpus[:24000]}"
        )
        try:
            result = self.llm.invoke(prompt)
            content = getattr(result, "content", result)
            if isinstance(content, list):
                content = " ".join(str(c.get("text", c)) if isinstance(c, dict) else str(c) for c in content)
            match = re.search(r"\{.*\}", str(content), re.S)
            return json.loads(match.group(0)) if match else {}
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            self.log(f"LLM extraction skipped: {exc}")
            return {}

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ main
    def extract(self) -> Data:
        case = dict(self.case.data) if isinstance(self.case, Data) else dict(self.case or {})
        documents = case.get("attachments", [])
        fields: dict[str, dict] = {}

        for field, (pattern, preferred_doc) in FIELD_PATTERNS.items():
            best = None
            for doc in documents:
                for page in doc["pages"]:
                    m = re.search(pattern, page["text"], re.I)
                    if not m:
                        continue
                    raw = m.group(1).strip()
                    value = _to_int(raw) if field in NUMERIC_FIELDS else raw
                    candidate = {
                        "value": value,
                        "raw": raw,
                        "source_doc": doc["name"],
                        "page": page["page"],
                        "confidence": 0.97 if doc["doc_type"] == preferred_doc else 0.80,
                        "method": "rule",
                    }
                    if best is None or candidate["confidence"] > best["confidence"]:
                        best = candidate
            if best:
                fields[field] = best

        # Census rows (one per employee)
        census_rows: list[dict] = []
        census_doc = next((d for d in documents if d["doc_type"] == "census"), None)
        as_of = date.today()
        if fields.get("census_date"):
            try:
                as_of = datetime.strptime(fields["census_date"]["value"], "%Y-%m-%d").date()
            except ValueError:
                pass
        if census_doc:
            for page in census_doc["pages"]:
                for m in CENSUS_ROW.finditer(page["text"]):
                    emp_id, name, dob, age, location, dependants = m.groups()
                    computed = self._age_on(dob, as_of)
                    census_rows.append(
                        {
                            "employee_id": emp_id,
                            "name": name.strip(),
                            "dob": dob,
                            "stated_age": int(age),
                            "computed_age": computed,
                            "age_consistent": computed is not None and abs(computed - int(age)) <= 1,
                            "location": location.strip(),
                            "dependants": int(dependants),
                            "source_doc": census_doc["name"],
                            "page": page["page"],
                        }
                    )

        # Detailed claims rows
        claims_rows: list[dict] = []
        claims_doc = next((d for d in documents if d["doc_type"] == "claims"), None)
        if claims_doc:
            for page in claims_doc["pages"]:
                for m in CLAIM_ROW.finditer(page["text"]):
                    claim_id, claim_date, emp_id, claim_type, amount = m.groups()
                    claims_rows.append(
                        {
                            "claim_id": claim_id,
                            "date": claim_date,
                            "employee_id": emp_id,
                            "type": claim_type.strip(),
                            "amount": _to_int(amount) or 0,
                            "source_doc": claims_doc["name"],
                            "page": page["page"],
                        }
                    )

        # LLM assist for anything still missing (free-form documents)
        missing = [f for f in FIELD_PATTERNS if f not in fields]
        if missing and self.llm is not None and self.use_llm_for_missing:
            for field, info in (self._llm_fill(missing, documents) or {}).items():
                if field in FIELD_PATTERNS and isinstance(info, dict) and info.get("value") not in (None, "", "null"):
                    raw = str(info["value"])
                    fields[field] = {
                        "value": _to_int(raw) if field in NUMERIC_FIELDS else raw,
                        "raw": raw,
                        "source_doc": info.get("source_doc") or "unknown",
                        "page": info.get("page"),
                        "confidence": 0.70,
                        "method": "llm",
                    }

        present_docs = {d["doc_type"] for d in documents}
        model = {
            "company_name": fields.get("company_name", {}).get("value"),
            "industry": fields.get("industry", {}).get("value"),
            "broker_name": fields.get("broker_name", {}).get("value") or case.get("email", {}).get("from"),
            "broker_email": fields.get("broker_email", {}).get("value") or case.get("email", {}).get("from"),
            "policy_type": fields.get("policy_type", {}).get("value") or "Group Medical Insurance",
            "coverage_start_date": fields.get("coverage_start_date", {}).get("value"),
            "employees_application": fields.get("application_total_employees", {}).get("value"),
            "employees_census_declared": fields.get("census_total_employees", {}).get("value"),
            "employees_census_rows": len(census_rows),
            "requested_sum_insured": fields.get("requested_sum_insured", {}).get("value"),
            "current_sum_insured": fields.get("current_sum_insured", {}).get("value"),
            "current_annual_premium": fields.get("current_annual_premium", {}).get("value"),
            "claims_total_summary": fields.get("claims_total_summary", {}).get("value"),
            "claims_total_detailed": fields.get("claims_total_detailed", {}).get("value"),
            "claims_rows_total": sum(c["amount"] for c in claims_rows),
            "policy_expiry_date": fields.get("policy_expiry_date", {}).get("value"),
            "dependants_total": sum(r["dependants"] for r in census_rows),
            "average_age": round(sum(r["stated_age"] for r in census_rows) / len(census_rows), 1) if census_rows else None,
            "documents_present": sorted(present_docs),
        }

        case["extraction"] = {
            "fields": fields,
            "census_rows": census_rows,
            "claims_rows": claims_rows,
            "data_model": model,
            "fields_found": len(fields),
            "fields_expected": len(FIELD_PATTERNS),
            "llm_used": any(f.get("method") == "llm" for f in fields.values()),
        }
        case.setdefault("audit_trail", []).append(
            {
                "step": "extraction",
                "detail": f"{len(fields)}/{len(FIELD_PATTERNS)} fields, {len(census_rows)} census rows, "
                f"{len(claims_rows)} claim rows",
            }
        )
        self.status = json.dumps(model, indent=2, default=str)
        return Data(data=case, text_key="intake_source")

"""Field-level validation engine.

Deterministic checks: mandatory fields, invalid formats, cross-document
mismatches (application vs census, claims summary vs detailed report), census
date-of-birth consistency and missing documents. Every finding carries the
source evidence and is classified as extraction error, data discrepancy,
missing field or missing document so the agent can decide what to do next.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re

from agentcore.custom.custom_node.node import Node
from agentcore.io import DataInput, IntInput, Output
from agentcore.schema.data import Data

MANDATORY = [
    ("company_name", "Company name"),
    ("application_total_employees", "Total employees (application)"),
    ("requested_sum_insured", "Requested sum insured"),
    ("coverage_start_date", "Coverage start date"),
    ("policy_expiry_date", "Current policy expiry"),
    ("claims_total_summary", "Claims amount (summary)"),
    ("current_annual_premium", "Current annual premium"),
]
REQUIRED_DOCS = {"application": "Company application", "census": "Employee census", "claims": "Claims experience", "policy": "Current policy"}


def _inr(value) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return "—"
    try:
        n = int(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return str(value)
    s = str(n)
    if len(s) <= 3:
        return f"₹{s}"
    head, tail = s[:-3], s[-3:]
    parts = []
    while len(head) > 2:
        parts.insert(0, head[-2:])
        head = head[:-2]
    if head:
        parts.insert(0, head)
    return "₹" + ",".join(parts) + "," + tail


class UnderwritingValidationEngine(Node):
    display_name = "3. Field-Level Validation"
    description = (
        "Checks mandatory fields, formats, cross-document consistency and census integrity; produces a validation "
        "report with evidence, completeness/validation scores and the list of material issues."
    )
    icon = "shield-check"
    name = "UnderwritingValidationEngine"

    inputs = [
        DataInput(name="extracted", display_name="Extracted Case", required=True),
        IntInput(
            name="employee_count_tolerance",
            display_name="Employee count tolerance",
            value=0,
            info="Allowed difference between the application head-count and the census before it is material.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        IntInput(
            name="claims_tolerance_pct",
            display_name="Claims mismatch tolerance (%)",
            value=2,
            info="Allowed difference between the claims summary and the detailed report before it is material.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
    ]

    outputs = [Output(display_name="Validated Case", name="validated", method="validate")]

    def validate(self) -> Data:
        case = dict(self.extracted.data) if isinstance(self.extracted, Data) else dict(self.extracted or {})
        extraction = case.get("extraction", {})
        fields = extraction.get("fields", {})
        model = extraction.get("data_model", {})
        census_rows = extraction.get("census_rows", [])
        report: list[dict] = []

        def add(field, label, source_value, result, issue_type=None, detail="", evidence=None, material=False):
            report.append(
                {
                    "field": field,
                    "label": label,
                    "source_value": source_value,
                    "result": result,  # PASS | FAIL | WARN
                    "issue_type": issue_type,  # extraction_error | data_discrepancy | missing_field | missing_document | invalid_format
                    "detail": detail,
                    "evidence": evidence or [],
                    "material": material,
                }
            )

        def ev(field):
            f = fields.get(field)
            return [{"doc": f["source_doc"], "page": f.get("page"), "confidence": f.get("confidence"), "method": f.get("method")}] if f else []

        # 1. Missing documents
        present = set(model.get("documents_present", []))
        for doc_type, label in REQUIRED_DOCS.items():
            if doc_type not in present:
                add(f"document:{doc_type}", label, "not received", "FAIL", "missing_document", f"{label} was not attached.", material=True)

        # 2. Mandatory fields
        for field, label in MANDATORY:
            f = fields.get(field)
            if f is None or f.get("value") in (None, ""):
                add(field, label, "missing", "FAIL", "missing_field", f"{label} could not be found in the attachments.",
                    material=field in {"policy_expiry_date", "application_total_employees", "requested_sum_insured", "company_name"})
            else:
                add(field, label, f["raw"] if field not in {"requested_sum_insured", "claims_total_summary", "current_annual_premium"} else _inr(f["value"]),
                    "PASS", None, f"Extracted from {f['source_doc']} p.{f.get('page')} (confidence {f.get('confidence')}).", ev(field))

        # 3. Formats
        for field in ("coverage_start_date", "policy_start_date", "policy_expiry_date", "census_date"):
            f = fields.get(field)
            if f and not re.fullmatch(r"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}", str(f["raw"])):
                add(field, field.replace("_", " ").title(), f["raw"], "FAIL", "invalid_format", "Expected ISO date YYYY-MM-DD.", ev(field), material=False)
        if fields.get("broker_email") and not re.fullmatch(r"[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+", str(fields["broker_email"]["raw"])):
            add("broker_email", "Broker email", fields["broker_email"]["raw"], "WARN", "invalid_format", "Email address format looks invalid.", ev("broker_email"))

        # 4. Cross-document: employees (application vs census)
        app_n = model.get("employees_application")
        census_n = model.get("employees_census_rows") or model.get("employees_census_declared")
        if app_n is not None and census_n:
            diff = abs(int(app_n) - int(census_n))
            if diff > int(self.employee_count_tolerance or 0):
                add("total_employees", "Total employees", f"{app_n} in application; {census_n} in census", "FAIL", "data_discrepancy",
                    f"Head-count differs by {diff}. The census is the rating basis; the broker must confirm the correct number.",
                    ev("application_total_employees") + ev("census_total_employees"), material=True)
            else:
                add("total_employees", "Total employees", f"{app_n} (application) = {census_n} (census)", "PASS", None, "Head-count consistent across documents.",
                    ev("application_total_employees") + ev("census_total_employees"))
        declared = model.get("employees_census_declared")
        rows = model.get("employees_census_rows")
        if declared and rows and int(declared) != int(rows):
            add("census_row_count", "Census row count", f"{rows} rows parsed; {declared} declared", "WARN", "extraction_error",
                "Parsed census rows differ from the declared total — possible table extraction issue; verify the census document.",
                ev("census_total_employees"))

        # 5. Census DOB / age consistency
        inconsistent = [r for r in census_rows if not r.get("age_consistent")]
        if census_rows:
            if inconsistent:
                sample = ", ".join(f"{r['employee_id']} (DOB {r['dob']}, stated {r['stated_age']}, computed {r['computed_age']}, p.{r['page']})" for r in inconsistent[:5])
                add("employee_dob", "Employee date of birth", f"Inconsistent for {len(inconsistent)} employee(s)", "FAIL", "data_discrepancy",
                    f"Stated age does not match date of birth: {sample}.", [{"doc": r["source_doc"], "page": r["page"]} for r in inconsistent[:5]],
                    material=len(inconsistent) >= 3)
            else:
                add("employee_dob", "Employee date of birth", f"Consistent for all {len(census_rows)} employees", "PASS")

        # 6. Claims summary vs detailed report
        s, d = model.get("claims_total_summary"), model.get("claims_total_detailed") or model.get("claims_rows_total")
        if s is not None and d:
            pct = abs(int(s) - int(d)) / max(int(d), 1) * 100
            if pct > float(self.claims_tolerance_pct or 0):
                add("claims_amount", "Claims amount", f"{_inr(s)} in summary; {_inr(d)} in detailed report", "FAIL", "data_discrepancy",
                    f"Summary and detailed claims differ by {pct:.1f}%. Loss ratio cannot be rated until the broker confirms the incurred claims.",
                    ev("claims_total_summary") + ev("claims_total_detailed"), material=True)
            else:
                add("claims_amount", "Claims amount", f"{_inr(s)} (summary) ≈ {_inr(d)} (detailed)", "PASS", None, "Claims figures reconcile.",
                    ev("claims_total_summary") + ev("claims_total_detailed"))

        # 7. Sum insured sanity
        si = model.get("requested_sum_insured")
        if si is not None and (int(si) < 100000 or int(si) > 5000000):
            add("requested_sum_insured_range", "Requested sum insured range", _inr(si), "WARN", "data_discrepancy",
                "Outside the usual ₹1 lakh – ₹50 lakh band for group medical cover; underwriter attention advised.", ev("requested_sum_insured"))

        # Scores
        total_fields = extraction.get("fields_expected") or 1
        completeness = round(100 * (extraction.get("fields_found") or 0) / total_fields)
        checks = [r for r in report if r["result"] in {"PASS", "FAIL"}]
        validation_score = round(100 * sum(1 for r in checks if r["result"] == "PASS") / max(len(checks), 1))
        material = [r for r in report if r["material"] and r["result"] == "FAIL"]
        status = "HOLD" if material else "PASS"

        case["validation"] = {
            "report": report,
            "completeness_score": completeness,
            "validation_score": validation_score,
            "material_issues": material,
            "warnings": [r for r in report if r["result"] == "WARN"],
            "status": status,
        }
        case.setdefault("audit_trail", []).append(
            {"step": "validation", "detail": f"{status}: {len(material)} material issue(s), completeness {completeness}%, validation {validation_score}%"}
        )
        self.status = json.dumps(
            {"status": status, "completeness": completeness, "validation_score": validation_score,
             "material_issues": [m["label"] for m in material]}, indent=2)
        return Data(data=case, text_key="intake_source")

"""Agentic decision step.

Looks at the validation outcome and the risk profile and decides the next
action: proceed to the approved rating engine, put the case on hold and ask the
broker for clarification, or refer it to an authorised underwriter.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json

from agentcore.custom.custom_node.node import Node
from agentcore.io import DataInput, FloatInput, IntInput, Output
from agentcore.schema.data import Data

PROCEED, CLARIFY, REFER = "PROCEED_TO_QUOTE", "REQUEST_CLARIFICATION", "REFER_TO_UNDERWRITER"


class UnderwritingDecisionRouter(Node):
    display_name = "4. Underwriting Decision"
    description = (
        "Decides the next action from the validation report and risk indicators: proceed to rating, request "
        "clarification from the broker (case on hold) or refer to an authorised underwriter."
    )
    icon = "git-branch"
    name = "UnderwritingDecisionRouter"

    inputs = [
        DataInput(name="validated", display_name="Validated Case", required=True),
        FloatInput(
            name="max_auto_loss_ratio",
            display_name="Max loss ratio for auto-quote",
            value=1.0,
            info="Incurred claims ÷ current annual premium above this value is referred to an underwriter.",
        ),
        IntInput(name="max_auto_employees", display_name="Max employees for auto-quote", value=1000),
        IntInput(name="max_auto_sum_insured", display_name="Max sum insured per employee for auto-quote", value=1000000),
        IntInput(
            name="min_validation_score",
            display_name="Minimum validation score (%)",
            value=70,
            info="Below this score the case is referred even when no single issue is material.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
    ]

    outputs = [Output(display_name="Decision", name="decision", method="decide")]

    def decide(self) -> Data:
        case = dict(self.validated.data) if isinstance(self.validated, Data) else dict(self.validated or {})
        validation = case.get("validation", {})
        model = case.get("extraction", {}).get("data_model", {})
        reasons: list[str] = []

        claims = model.get("claims_total_detailed") or model.get("claims_rows_total") or model.get("claims_total_summary")
        premium = model.get("current_annual_premium")
        loss_ratio = round(int(claims) / int(premium), 2) if claims and premium else None
        employees = model.get("employees_census_rows") or model.get("employees_application") or 0
        sum_insured = model.get("requested_sum_insured") or 0

        if validation.get("material_issues"):
            action = CLARIFY
            reasons = [f"{m['label']}: {m['detail']}" for m in validation["material_issues"]]
        else:
            if loss_ratio is not None and loss_ratio > float(self.max_auto_loss_ratio or 1.0):
                reasons.append(f"Loss ratio {loss_ratio} exceeds the auto-quote limit of {self.max_auto_loss_ratio}.")
            if int(employees) > int(self.max_auto_employees or 1000):
                reasons.append(f"Group size {employees} exceeds the auto-quote limit of {self.max_auto_employees}.")
            if int(sum_insured) > int(self.max_auto_sum_insured or 1000000):
                reasons.append(f"Requested sum insured {sum_insured} exceeds the auto-quote limit of {self.max_auto_sum_insured}.")
            if int(validation.get("validation_score", 0)) < int(self.min_validation_score or 0):
                reasons.append(f"Validation score {validation.get('validation_score')}% is below {self.min_validation_score}%.")
            action = REFER if reasons else PROCEED
            if action == PROCEED:
                reasons = ["All critical fields validated; risk indicators within the auto-quote authority."]

        if loss_ratio is None:
            risk_tier = "UNKNOWN"
        elif loss_ratio < 0.6:
            risk_tier = "LOW"
        elif loss_ratio <= 0.85:
            risk_tier = "MEDIUM"
        else:
            risk_tier = "HIGH"

        case["decision"] = {
            "next_action": action,
            "reasons": reasons,
            "loss_ratio": loss_ratio,
            "risk_tier": risk_tier,
            "employees_considered": employees,
            "warnings": [w["label"] for w in validation.get("warnings", [])],
        }
        case.setdefault("audit_trail", []).append({"step": "decision", "detail": f"{action} ({risk_tier} risk, loss ratio {loss_ratio})"})
        self.status = json.dumps(case["decision"], indent=2)
        return Data(data=case, text_key="intake_source")

"""Configurable rating engine (mock insurer rating table).

Premiums are computed only from the configured rating table — never by the
LLM. The table can be edited on the node or replaced by a call to the
insurer's rating API later.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json

from agentcore.custom.custom_node.node import Node
from agentcore.io import BoolInput, DataInput, MultilineInput, Output
from agentcore.schema.data import Data

DEFAULT_RATING_TABLE = {
    "currency": "INR",
    "base_sum_insured": 500000,
    "age_band_rates": [
        {"band": "18-29", "max_age": 29, "rate": 4000},
        {"band": "30-39", "max_age": 39, "rate": 5400},
        {"band": "40-49", "max_age": 49, "rate": 7600},
        {"band": "50+", "max_age": 120, "rate": 10500},
    ],
    "fallback_rate_per_employee": 6000,
    "dependant_loading_pct": 15,
    "claims_experience_adjustment": [
        {"max_loss_ratio": 0.6, "adjust_pct": -5, "label": "Favourable claims experience discount"},
        {"max_loss_ratio": 0.85, "adjust_pct": 0, "label": "Neutral claims experience"},
        {"max_loss_ratio": 1.0, "adjust_pct": 15, "label": "Adverse claims experience loading"},
        {"max_loss_ratio": 99, "adjust_pct": 30, "label": "Severe claims experience loading"},
    ],
    "minimum_premium_per_employee": 2500,
    "gst_pct": 18,
    "quote_validity_days": 30,
}


class UnderwritingRatingEngine(Node):
    display_name = "5. Rating Engine (configurable table)"
    description = (
        "Applies the insurer's configured rating table: age-band rates, sum-insured factor, dependant loading and "
        "claims-experience adjustment. Deterministic — the LLM never sets a price."
    )
    icon = "calculator"
    name = "UnderwritingRatingEngine"

    inputs = [
        DataInput(name="decision", display_name="Decision", required=True),
        MultilineInput(
            name="rating_table",
            display_name="Rating table (JSON)",
            value=json.dumps(DEFAULT_RATING_TABLE, indent=2),
            info="Insurer rating table. Replace with the approved tables or a rating-API call.",
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="rate_if_on_hold",
            display_name="Compute indicative premium when on hold",
            value=False,
            info="If true, an indicative (non-binding) premium is computed even when the case is on hold or referred.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
    ]

    outputs = [Output(display_name="Rated Case", name="rated", method="rate")]

    def rate(self) -> Data:
        case = dict(self.decision.data) if isinstance(self.decision, Data) else dict(self.decision or {})
        decision = case.get("decision", {})
        model = case.get("extraction", {}).get("data_model", {})
        census_rows = case.get("extraction", {}).get("census_rows", [])

        try:
            table = json.loads(self.rating_table) if self.rating_table else DEFAULT_RATING_TABLE
        except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
            msg = f"Rating table is not valid JSON: {exc}"
            raise ValueError(msg) from exc

        should_rate = decision.get("next_action") == "PROCEED_TO_QUOTE" or bool(self.rate_if_on_hold)
        if not should_rate:
            case["rating"] = {"status": "SKIPPED", "reason": f"Rating not performed: decision is {decision.get('next_action')}."}
            case.setdefault("audit_trail", []).append({"step": "rating", "detail": "skipped (case not cleared for quotation)"})
            self.status = case["rating"]["reason"]
            return Data(data=case, text_key="intake_source")

        sum_insured = int(model.get("requested_sum_insured") or table["base_sum_insured"])
        si_factor = round(sum_insured / int(table["base_sum_insured"]), 4)
        bands = sorted(table["age_band_rates"], key=lambda b: b["max_age"])

        def band_for(age: int) -> dict:
            return next((b for b in bands if age <= int(b["max_age"])), bands[-1])

        band_breakdown: dict[str, dict] = {}
        employee_base = 0.0
        if census_rows:
            for row in census_rows:
                band = band_for(int(row.get("stated_age") or 0))
                entry = band_breakdown.setdefault(band["band"], {"employees": 0, "rate": band["rate"], "premium": 0.0})
                entry["employees"] += 1
                entry["premium"] += band["rate"] * si_factor
                employee_base += band["rate"] * si_factor
            employees = len(census_rows)
            dependants = int(model.get("dependants_total") or 0)
        else:
            employees = int(model.get("employees_application") or 0)
            employee_base = employees * table["fallback_rate_per_employee"] * si_factor
            band_breakdown["flat"] = {"employees": employees, "rate": table["fallback_rate_per_employee"], "premium": employee_base}
            dependants = 0

        avg_rate = employee_base / employees if employees else 0
        dependant_loading = dependants * avg_rate * (float(table["dependant_loading_pct"]) / 100)
        subtotal = employee_base + dependant_loading

        loss_ratio = decision.get("loss_ratio")
        adjustment = next(
            (a for a in sorted(table["claims_experience_adjustment"], key=lambda a: a["max_loss_ratio"])
             if loss_ratio is not None and float(loss_ratio) <= float(a["max_loss_ratio"])),
            {"adjust_pct": 0, "label": "No claims experience available"},
        )
        claims_adjustment = subtotal * float(adjustment["adjust_pct"]) / 100
        premium = subtotal + claims_adjustment
        minimum = employees * float(table["minimum_premium_per_employee"])
        minimum_applied = premium < minimum
        premium = max(premium, minimum)
        gst = premium * float(table["gst_pct"]) / 100

        def r(x: float) -> int:
            return int(round(x))

        case["rating"] = {
            "status": "INDICATIVE" if decision.get("next_action") != "PROCEED_TO_QUOTE" else "RATED",
            "currency": table.get("currency", "INR"),
            "covered_employees": employees,
            "dependants": dependants,
            "sum_insured_per_employee": sum_insured,
            "sum_insured_factor": si_factor,
            "age_band_breakdown": {k: {"employees": v["employees"], "rate": v["rate"], "premium": r(v["premium"])} for k, v in band_breakdown.items()},
            "employee_base_premium": r(employee_base),
            "dependant_loading": r(dependant_loading),
            "dependant_loading_pct": table["dependant_loading_pct"],
            "loss_ratio": loss_ratio,
            "claims_adjustment_label": adjustment["label"],
            "claims_adjustment_pct": adjustment["adjust_pct"],
            "claims_adjustment": r(claims_adjustment),
            "minimum_premium_applied": minimum_applied,
            "annual_premium": r(premium),
            "gst_pct": table["gst_pct"],
            "gst": r(gst),
            "total_payable": r(premium + gst),
            "premium_per_employee": r(premium / employees) if employees else 0,
            "quote_validity_days": table.get("quote_validity_days", 30),
            "rating_basis": "Configured rating table (illustrative, not actuarially validated)",
        }
        case.setdefault("audit_trail", []).append(
            {"step": "rating", "detail": f"{case['rating']['status']}: annual premium {case['rating']['annual_premium']} for {employees} employees"}
        )
        self.status = json.dumps(case["rating"], indent=2)
        return Data(data=case, text_key="intake_source")

Produces the quotation PDF (when the case is cleared), drafts the outbound
email for the decided action (quote / clarification / referral), optionally
polishes the wording with the LLM (numbers are never changed), and either keeps
the email as a draft pending approval or sends it through SMTP.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import io
import os
import re
import smtplib
from datetime import date, timedelta
from email.message import EmailMessage
from pathlib import Path

from agentcore.custom.custom_node.node import Node
from agentcore.io import BoolInput, DataInput, DropdownInput, HandleInput, Output, StrInput

DRAFT = "Draft only (requires approval)"
SEND = "Send via SMTP when approved"
SEND_OUTLOOK = "Send via Outlook connector when approved"


def inr(value) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return "—"
    try:
        n = int(round(float(value)))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return str(value)
    s = str(abs(n))
    if len(s) > 3:
        head, tail = s[:-3], s[-3:]
        parts = []
        while len(head) > 2:
            parts.insert(0, head[-2:])
            head = head[:-2]
        if head:
            parts.insert(0, head)
        s = ",".join(parts) + "," + tail
    return ("-" if n < 0 else "") + "₹" + s

        else:
            subject = f"RE: {subject_in} — Submission under underwriter review"
            reasons = "\n".join(f"  • {x}" for x in decision["reasons"])
            body = (
                f"Dear {broker},\n\n"
                f"Thank you for the Group Medical Insurance submission for {company}. The documents have been validated and the "
                "case has been referred to an authorised underwriter for review because of the following risk indicators:\n\n"
                f"{reasons}\n\n"
                "We will revert with the underwriting decision and quotation shortly.\n\n"
                f"Regards,\n{self.underwriter_signature}\n{self.insurer_name}"
            )

        body = self._polish(body)
        return {"to": to_addr, "subject": subject, "body": body, "action": action}

    def _polish(self, body: str) -> str:
        if self.llm is None:
            return body
        numbers = set(re.findall(r"[₹\d][\d,.%]*", body))
        prompt = (
            "Rewrite the following insurance underwriting email so it is concise, professional and courteous. "
            "Keep every number, amount, date, name and bullet exactly as given, keep the same structure and sign-off, "
            "and return ONLY the email body.\n\n" + body
        )
        try:
            result = self.llm.invoke(prompt)
            content = getattr(result, "content", result)
            if isinstance(content, list):
                content = "\n".join(str(c.get("text", c)) if isinstance(c, dict) else str(c) for c in content)
            polished = str(content).strip()
            # Safety: every figure in the original must survive the rewrite, otherwise keep the deterministic draft.
            if polished and all(n in polished for n in numbers if any(ch.isdigit() for ch in n)):
                return polished
            self.log("LLM rewrite dropped a figure; keeping the deterministic draft.")
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            self.log(f"LLM polish skipped: {exc}")
        return body

    def _send_via_outlook(self, email: dict, attachment: tuple[str, bytes] | None, case: dict) -> str:
        """Reply from the mailbox the email was read from, using the product's Outlook connector."""
        import base64

        import httpx
        from agentcore.components.tools.outlook_mail import (
            GRAPH_BASE,
            _gate_with_refresh_retry,
            _get_outlook_config,
            _refresh_token_sync,
        )

        source = case.get("source_mailbox") or {}
        connector_id = source.get("connector_id")
        if not connector_id:
            return "NOT SENT — Outlook dispatch needs the Outlook mailbox intake (no source mailbox on this case)"
        if not email.get("to"):
            return "NOT SENT — no recipient address (broker email not found)"
        config = _get_outlook_config(connector_id)
        if not config:
            return "NOT SENT — Outlook connector not found"
        config["_connector_id"] = connector_id
        accounts = config.get("linked_accounts", [])
        acct = next((a for a in accounts if a.get("email", "").lower() == str(source.get("account_email", "")).lower()), None) or (accounts[0] if accounts else None)
        if acct is None:
            return "NOT SENT — no mailbox linked to the Outlook connector"
        try:
            _gate_with_refresh_retry(config, acct, "Mail.Send")
            token = _refresh_token_sync(config, acct)
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            return f"NOT SENT — {exc}"

        message: dict = {
            "subject": email["subject"],
            "body": {"contentType": "Text", "content": email["body"]},
            "toRecipients": [{"emailAddress": {"address": email["to"]}}],
        }
        if attachment:
            message["attachments"] = [
                {
                    "@odata.type": "#microsoft.graph.fileAttachment",
                    "name": attachment[0],
                    "contentType": "application/pdf",
                    "contentBytes": base64.b64encode(attachment[1]).decode("ascii"),
                }
            ]
        try:
            resp = httpx.post(
                f"{GRAPH_BASE}/me/sendMail",
                headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}", "Content-Type": "application/json"},
                json={"message": message, "saveToSentItems": True},
                timeout=60,
            )
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            return f"FAILED — {exc}"
        if resp.status_code in (200, 202):
            return f"SENT from {acct.get('email')} to {email['to']} via Outlook" + (" with quote PDF" if attachment else "")
        return f"FAILED — Microsoft Graph {resp.status_code}: {resp.text[:200]}"

    def _dispatch(self, email: dict, attachment: tuple[str, bytes] | None, case: dict | None = None) -> str:
        if self.dispatch_mode not in (SEND, SEND_OUTLOOK):
            return "DRAFT — awaiting approval (dispatch mode: draft only)"
        if not self.approved:
            return "HELD — 'Approved by authorised underwriter' is not set"
        if self.dispatch_mode == SEND_OUTLOOK:
            return self._send_via_outlook(email, attachment, case or {})
        host = os.getenv("SMTP_HOST") or os.getenv("SMTP_SERVER")
        if not host or not email.get("to"):
            return "NOT SENT — SMTP_HOST or recipient address not configured"
        try:
            msg = EmailMessage()
            msg["From"] = os.getenv("SMTP_FROM_EMAIL") or os.getenv("SMTP_FROM") or os.getenv("SMTP_USERNAME") or "underwriting@example.com"
            msg["To"] = email["to"]
            msg["Subject"] = email["subject"]
            msg.set_content(email["body"])
            if attachment:
                msg.add_attachment(attachment[1], maintype="application", subtype="pdf", filename=attachment[0])
            port = int(os.getenv("SMTP_PORT") or 587)
            use_ssl = (os.getenv("SMTP_USE_SSL") or "false").lower() in {"1", "true", "yes"}
            smtp_cls = smtplib.SMTP_SSL if use_ssl else smtplib.SMTP
            with smtp_cls(host, port, timeout=20) as s:
                if not use_ssl and (os.getenv("SMTP_USE_TLS") or "true").lower() in {"1", "true", "yes"}:
                    s.starttls()
                user = os.getenv("SMTP_USERNAME") or os.getenv("SMTP_USER")
                if user:
                    s.login(user, os.getenv("SMTP_PASSWORD") or "")
                s.send_message(msg)
            return f"SENT to {email['to']} via {host}"
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            return f"FAILED — {exc}"

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ outputs
    def _case(self) -> dict:
        return dict(self.rated.data) if isinstance(self.rated, Data) else dict(self.rated or {})

    async def compose(self) -> Message:
        case = self._case()
        model = case.get("extraction", {}).get("data_model", {})
        validation = case.get("validation", {})
        decision = case.get("decision", {})
        rating = case.get("rating", {})
        email = self._draft_email(case)

        attachment = None
        files: list[str] = []
        pdf_note = ""
        if decision.get("next_action") == "PROCEED_TO_QUOTE" and rating.get("status") == "RATED":
            pdf_bytes = self._build_quote_pdf(case, self.insurer_name)
            filename = f"Quote_{re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9]+', '_', model.get('company_name') or 'proposer')}_{case.get('case_id')}.pdf"
            attachment = (filename, pdf_bytes)
            try:
                from agentcore.services.deps import get_storage_service

                agent_id = str(self.agent_id or "underwriting")
                await get_storage_service().save_file(agent_id, filename, pdf_bytes)
                files.append(f"{agent_id}/{filename}")
                pdf_note = f"Quote PDF saved as `{agent_id}/{filename}` in the agent's file storage."
            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
                pdf_note = f"Quote PDF generated in memory (storage save failed: {exc})."
            if (self.output_folder or "").strip():
                out = Path(self.output_folder.strip())
                out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                (out / filename).write_bytes(pdf_bytes)
                pdf_note += f" Copy written to `{out / filename}`."

        dispatch_status = self._dispatch(email, attachment, case)
        case["outbound_email"] = {**email, "dispatch_status": dispatch_status, "attachment": attachment[0] if attachment else None}
        case.setdefault("audit_trail", []).append({"step": "dispatch", "detail": dispatch_status})

        # ---------------- markdown review
        action_label = {
            "PROCEED_TO_QUOTE": "✅ Proceed to quotation",
            "REQUEST_CLARIFICATION": "⚠️ Clarification requested — case on hold",
            "REFER_TO_UNDERWRITER": "🔍 Referred to authorised underwriter",
        }.get(decision.get("next_action"), decision.get("next_action"))

        lines = [
            f"## Underwriting review — {model.get('company_name') or 'Unknown proposer'}",
            f"**Case** `{case.get('case_id')}` · intake: {case.get('intake_source')} · "
            f"documents: {', '.join(a['name'] for a in case.get('attachments', []))}",
            "",
            f"### Decision: {action_label}",
            *[f"- {r}" for r in decision.get("reasons", [])],
            f"- Risk tier: **{decision.get('risk_tier')}** · loss ratio: **{decision.get('loss_ratio')}** · "
            f"completeness: **{validation.get('completeness_score')}%** · validation score: **{validation.get('validation_score')}%**",
            "",
            "### Field-level validation",
            "| Field | Source value | Result | Type | Evidence |",
            "|---|---|---|---|---|",
        ]
        for r in validation.get("report", []):
            icon = {"PASS": "✅", "FAIL": "❌", "WARN": "⚠️"}.get(r["result"], "")
            evidence = "; ".join(f"{e.get('doc')} p.{e.get('page')}" + (f" ({e.get('confidence')})" if e.get("confidence") else "") for e in r.get("evidence", [])[:2])
            lines.append(f"| {r['label']} | {r['source_value']} | {icon} {r['result']} | {r.get('issue_type') or ''} | {evidence} |")

        lines += ["", "### Extracted data model", "| Field | Value |", "|---|---|"]
        for k, v in model.items():
            if k == "documents_present":
                v = ", ".join(v)
            elif k in {"requested_sum_insured", "current_sum_insured", "current_annual_premium", "claims_total_summary", "claims_total_detailed", "claims_rows_total"}:
                v = inr(v)
            lines.append(f"| {k.replace('_', ' ')} | {v if v is not None else '—'} |")

        if rating.get("status") in {"RATED", "INDICATIVE"}:
            lines += [
                "",
                f"### Rating & quotation ({rating['status'].lower()})",
                "| Item | Amount |",
                "|---|---|",
                f"| Covered employees | {rating['covered_employees']} (dependants {rating['dependants']}) |",
                f"| Sum insured per employee | {inr(rating['sum_insured_per_employee'])} |",
                f"| Employee base premium | {inr(rating['employee_base_premium'])} |",
                f"| Dependant loading ({rating['dependant_loading_pct']}%) | {inr(rating['dependant_loading'])} |",
                f"| {rating['claims_adjustment_label']} ({rating['claims_adjustment_pct']:+}%) | {inr(rating['claims_adjustment'])} |",
                f"| **Annual premium (excl. GST)** | **{inr(rating['annual_premium'])}** |",
                f"| GST @ {rating['gst_pct']}% | {inr(rating['gst'])} |",
                f"| Total payable | {inr(rating['total_payable'])} |",
                "",
                f"_{rating['rating_basis']}._ {pdf_note}",
            ]
        elif rating:
            lines += ["", f"### Rating: {rating.get('reason')}"]

        lines += [
            "",
            f"### Outbound email — {dispatch_status}",
            f"**To:** {email['to'] or '—'}  ",
            f"**Subject:** {email['subject']}",
            "",
            "```",
            email["body"],
            "```",
            "",
            "### Audit trail",
            *[f"{i}. **{a['step']}** — {a['detail']}" for i, a in enumerate(case.get("audit_trail", []), 1)],
        ]

        self._case_record = case
        self.status = action_label
        return Message(text="\n".join(lines), files=files, sender="Machine", sender_name="Underwriting Agent")

    def case_record(self) -> Data:
        case = getattr(self, "_case_record", None) or self._case()
        return Data(data=case, text_key="intake_source")

import base64

# Regex to find base64 image data URLs in markdown and raw strings
_BASE64_IMG_MD_RE = re.compile(r"!\[([^\]]*)\]\((data:image/([^;]+);base64,([A-Za-z0-9+/=\s]+))\)")
_BASE64_DATA_URL_RE = re.compile(r"data:image/([^;]+);base64,([A-Za-z0-9+/=\s]+)")


class ChatOutput(ChatNode):
    display_name = "Chat Output"
    description = "Display a chat message in the Playground."
    icon = "MessagesSquare"
    name = "ChatOutput"
    minimized = True

    inputs = [

    def _build_source(self, id_: str | None, display_name: str | None, source: str | None) -> Source:
        source_dict = {}
        if id_:
            source_dict["id"] = id_
        if display_name:
            source_dict["display_name"] = display_name
        if source:
            # Handle case where source is a ChatOpenAI object
            if hasattr(source, "model_name"):
                source_dict["source"] = source.model_name
            elif hasattr(source, "model"):
                source_dict["source"] = str(source.model)
            else:
                source_dict["source"] = str(source)
        return Source(**source_dict)

    async def message_response(self) -> Message:
        # Check if input is already a stored Message (has an ID)
        # This happens when input comes from Agent component which already stores its response
        input_already_stored = (
            isinstance(self.input_value, Message) 
            and hasattr(self.input_value, "id") 
            and self.input_value.id is not None
        )
        
        # First convert the input to string if needed
        text = self.convert_to_string()

        # Get source properties
        source, icon, display_name, source_id = self.get_properties_from_source_component()
        background_color = self.background_color
        text_color = self.text_color
        if self.chat_icon:
            icon = self.chat_icon

        # If input is already a stored Message, just return it with updated properties
        # Don't create a new message to avoid duplicate storage
        if input_already_stored:
            message = self.input_value
            # Update properties if user has customized them
            if background_color:
                message.properties.background_color = background_color
            if text_color:
                message.properties.text_color = text_color
            if self.chat_icon:
                message.properties.icon = icon
            # Persist any base64 images to blob storage
            await self._persist_ai_images(message)
            self.status = message
            # Update STM cache even for pre-stored messages (e.g. Agent component responses)
            await self._update_stm_cache(message)
            if message.sender == MESSAGE_SENDER_AI:
                preview = (message.text or "")[:150]
                logger.info(f"[AI_MESSAGE] AI: {preview}")
            return message

        # IMPORTANT: Create a NEW Message object for non-stored inputs
        # If we reuse the input message (which may have an ID from a previous store),
        # astore_message will UPDATE that existing record instead of creating a new one.
        message = Message(text=text)
        # Preserve content_blocks from the input message (e.g. SupervisorAgent trace steps)
        if isinstance(self.input_value, Message) and self.input_value.content_blocks:
            message.content_blocks = self.input_value.content_blocks

        # Set message properties
        message.sender = self.sender
        message.sender_name = self.sender_name
        message.session_id = self.session_id
        message.agent_id = self.graph.agent_id if hasattr(self, "graph") else None
        message.properties.source = self._build_source(source_id, display_name, source)
        message.properties.icon = icon
        message.properties.background_color = background_color
        message.properties.text_color = text_color

        # Persist any base64 images in the AI response to blob storage
        # (replaces data URLs with file-serving URLs before DB store)
        await self._persist_ai_images(message)

        # Store message if needed
        if self.session_id and self.should_store_message:
            stored_message = await self.send_message(message)
            self.message.value = stored_message
            message = stored_message

            await self._update_stm_cache(message)

        self.status = message
        if message.sender == MESSAGE_SENDER_AI:
            preview = (message.text or "")[:150]
            logger.info(f"[AI_MESSAGE] AI: {preview}")
        return message

    async def _persist_ai_images(self, message: Message) -> None:
        """Extract base64 images from the AI response, save them to storage,
        and replace the inline data URLs with proper file-serving URLs.

        Handles images in:
        1. Markdown in message.text  — ``![alt](data:image/png;base64,...)``
        2. content_blocks → MediaContent.urls  — raw ``data:image/...`` URLs
        3. content_blocks → ToolContent.output  — markdown with data URLs
        """
        try:
            from agentcore.services.deps import get_storage_service

            storage_service = get_storage_service()
        except Exception:
            logger.debug("[ChatOutput] Storage service unavailable, skipping image persistence")
            return

        agent_id = str(self.graph.agent_id) if hasattr(self, "graph") and self.graph.agent_id else None
        if not agent_id:
            return

        saved_paths: list[str] = []
        counter = 0

        async def _save_and_get_url(img_format: str, b64_data: str) -> str | None:
            """Decode base64, save to storage, return the serving URL."""
            nonlocal counter
            try:
                raw = base64.b64decode(b64_data.replace("\n", "").replace(" ", ""))
            except Exception:
                return None
            ext = img_format.split("+")[0]  # e.g. "svg+xml" → "svg"
            ts = datetime.now(tz=timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M-%S")
            file_name = f"{ts}_ai_generated_{counter}.{ext}"
            counter += 1
            await storage_service.save_file(agent_id=agent_id, file_name=file_name, data=raw)
            file_path = f"{agent_id}/{file_name}"
            saved_paths.append(file_path)
            return f"{IMAGE_ENDPOINT}{file_path}"

        # --- 1. Process markdown images in message.text ---
        if isinstance(message.text, str):
            new_text = message.text
            for match in list(_BASE64_IMG_MD_RE.finditer(new_text)):
                alt = match.group(1)
                img_format = match.group(3)
                b64_data = match.group(4)
                url = await _save_and_get_url(img_format, b64_data)
                if url:
                    new_text = new_text.replace(match.group(0), f"![{alt}]({url})")
            message.text = new_text

        # --- 2. Process content_blocks ---
        for block in message.content_blocks or []:
            for content in block.contents:
                # MediaContent — urls list may contain data URLs
                if isinstance(content, MediaContent):
                    new_urls = []
                    for url in content.urls:
                        m = _BASE64_DATA_URL_RE.match(url)
                        if m:
                            stored_url = await _save_and_get_url(m.group(1), m.group(2))
                            new_urls.append(stored_url or url)
                        else:
                            new_urls.append(url)
                    content.urls = new_urls

                # ToolContent — output may contain markdown with data URLs
                if isinstance(content, ToolContent) and content.output:
                    output_str = str(content.output)
                    for match in list(_BASE64_IMG_MD_RE.finditer(output_str)):
                        alt = match.group(1)
                        img_format = match.group(3)
                        b64_data = match.group(4)
                        url = await _save_and_get_url(img_format, b64_data)
                        if url:
                            output_str = output_str.replace(match.group(0), f"![{alt}]({url})")
                    content.output = output_str

        # --- 3. Add saved images to message.files for DB storage ---
        if saved_paths:
            if not message.files:
                message.files = []
            message.files.extend(saved_paths)
            logger.info(f"[ChatOutput] Persisted {len(saved_paths)} AI-generated images to storage for agent={agent_id}")

    @staticmethod
    def _message_to_cache_entry(message: Message) -> dict:
        """Serialize a Message to a dict suitable for STM Redis cache."""
        entry = {
            "text": message.text or "",
            "sender": message.sender or "",
            "sender_name": message.sender_name or "",
            "files": [str(f.path) if hasattr(f, "path") else str(f) for f in (message.files or [])],
        }
        # Persist content_blocks (e.g. media/images returned by the LLM)
        if message.content_blocks:
            entry["content_blocks"] = [
                cb.model_dump() if hasattr(cb, "model_dump") else cb
                for cb in message.content_blocks
            ]
        return entry

    async def _update_stm_cache(self, message: Message) -> None:
        """Append the message to all STM cache entries for this session."""
        session_id = self.session_id
        if not session_id:
            return
        try:
            import json

            from agentcore.services.cache.redis_client import get_redis_client
            from agentcore.services.deps import get_settings_service

            settings_service = get_settings_service()
            if settings_service.settings.cache_type != "redis":
                return
            redis_client = get_redis_client(settings_service)
            ttl = getattr(settings_service.settings, "stm_cache_ttl", 300)
            stm_prefix = "stm:history:"
            pattern = f"{stm_prefix}{session_id}:*"
            ai_entry = self._message_to_cache_entry(message)
            async for key in redis_client.scan_iter(match=pattern, count=100):
                existing = await redis_client.get(key)
                if existing:
                    cached_msgs = json.loads(existing)
                    cached_msgs.append(ai_entry)
                    # Trim to the n_messages limit (extract from key: stm:history:{sid}:{n})
                    try:
                        n_limit = int(str(key).rsplit(":", 1)[-1])
                        if n_limit and len(cached_msgs) > n_limit:
                            cached_msgs = cached_msgs[-n_limit:]
                    except (ValueError, IndexError):
                        pass
                    await redis_client.setex(key, ttl, json.dumps(cached_msgs))
                    logger.info(
                        f"[ChatOutput] Updated STM cache for session={session_id}, "
                        f"total={len(cached_msgs)} msgs"
                    )
        except Exception as e:
            logger.debug(f"[ChatOutput] STM cache update skipped: {e}")

    def _serialize_data(self, data: Data) -> str:
        """Serialize Data object to JSON string."""
        # Convert data.data to JSON-serializable format
        serializable_data = jsonable_encoder(data.data)
        # Serialize with orjson, enabling pretty printing with indentation
        json_bytes = orjson.dumps(serializable_data, option=orjson.OPT_INDENT_2)
        # Convert bytes to string and wrap in Markdown code blocks
        return "```json\n" + json_bytes.decode("utf-8") + "\n```"

    def _validate_input(self) -> None:
        """Validate the input data and raise ValueError if invalid."""
        if self.input_value is None:
            msg = "Input data cannot be None"
            raise ValueError(msg)
        if isinstance(self.input_value, list) and not all(
            isinstance(item, Message | Data | DataFrame | str) for item in self.input_value
        ):
            invalid_types = [
                type(item).__name__
                for item in self.input_value
                if not isinstance(item, Message | Data | DataFrame | str)
            ]
            msg = f"Expected Data or DataFrame or Message or str, got {invalid_types}"
            raise TypeError(msg)
        if not isinstance(
            self.input_value,
            Message | Data | DataFrame | str | list | Generator | type(None),
        ):
            type_name = type(self.input_value).__name__
            msg = f"Expected Data or DataFrame or Message or str, Generator or None, got {type_name}"
            raise TypeError(msg)

    def convert_to_string(self) -> str | Generator[Any, None, None]:
        """Convert input data to string with proper error handling."""
        self._validate_input()
        if isinstance(self.input_value, list):
            return "\n".join([safe_convert(item, clean_data=self.clean_data) for item in self.input_value])
        if isinstance(self.input_value, Generator):
            return self.input_value
        return safe_convert(self.input_value)

"""Unified Language Model component — thin wrapper around the Model microservice.

All LLM invocations are delegated to the Model microservice via
``MicroserviceChatModel``.  No provider SDKs are imported here.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from loguru import logger

from agentcore.base.models.model import LCModelNode
from agentcore.field_typing import LanguageModel
from agentcore.io import DropdownInput, FloatInput, IntInput

from agentcore.components.models._rbac_helpers import (
    check_model_access_sync,
    fetch_model_by_id_sync,
    filter_models_by_rbac,
    is_public_registry_agent_run,
    resolve_user_id,
)

# Display label → DB key mapping
PROVIDER_LABEL_TO_KEY = {
    "OpenAI": "openai",
    "Azure": "azure",
    "Anthropic": "anthropic",
    "Google": "google",
    "Google Vertex AI": "google_vertex",
    "Groq": "groq",
    "Custom Model": "openai_compatible",
}
PROVIDER_KEY_TO_LABEL = {v: k for k, v in PROVIDER_LABEL_TO_KEY.items()}
PROVIDER_OPTIONS = list(PROVIDER_LABEL_TO_KEY.keys())


def _fetch_models_for_provider(provider: str, user_id: str | None = None) -> list[str]:
    """Fetch active LLM models from the microservice, filtered by provider and RBAC.

    Returns a list of strings formatted as ``'display_name | model_name | uuid'``.
    """
    if not provider:
        return []
    try:
        from agentcore.services.model_service_client import fetch_registry_models

        results = fetch_registry_models(provider=provider, model_type="llm")
        if user_id:
            results = filter_models_by_rbac(results, user_id)
        # Filter: only show models meant for agent canvas
        results = [
            r for r in results
            if "agent" in (r.get("show_in") or ["orchestrator", "agent"])
        ]
        return [
            f"{r['display_name']} | {r['model_name']} | {r['id']}"
            for r in results
        ]
    except Exception as e:
        logger.warning(f"Failed to fetch LLM models via microservice: {e}")
        return []


class RegistryModelComponent(LCModelNode):
    """A unified Language Model component that dynamically loads models from the Model Registry.

    Users onboard models via the Model Registry page.  This component
    lets them pick a provider, then select a registered model for that
    provider in the agent builder.
    """

    display_name: str = "Large Language Model"
    description: str = "Select a provider and model from the Model Registry to power your agent."
    icon = "BrainCircuit"
    name = "RegistryModelComponent"
    priority = 0

    inputs = [
        *LCModelNode._base_inputs,
        DropdownInput(
            name="provider",
            display_name="Provider",
            info="Select the AI provider. Models onboarded for this provider will appear below.",
            options=PROVIDER_OPTIONS,
            value="",
            real_time_refresh=True,
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="registry_model",
            display_name="Registry Model",
            info="Select a model from the Model Registry.",
            options=[],
            value="",
            refresh_button=True,
            real_time_refresh=True,
            combobox=True,
        ),
        FloatInput(
            name="temperature",
            display_name="Temperature",
            info="Controls randomness (0-2). Leave empty to use model default.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        IntInput(
            name="max_tokens",
            display_name="Max Output Tokens",
            info="Maximum number of tokens to generate. Leave empty for model default.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
    ]

    def update_build_config(self, build_config: dict, field_value: str, field_name: str | None = None):
        """Refresh dropdowns when provider changes or registry_model refresh is clicked."""
        current_user_id = resolve_user_id(self)

        if field_name == "provider":
            provider_key = PROVIDER_LABEL_TO_KEY.get(field_value, field_value)
            try:
                options = _fetch_models_for_provider(provider_key, user_id=current_user_id)
                build_config["registry_model"]["options"] = options if options else []
                build_config["registry_model"]["value"] = options[0] if options else ""
            except Exception as e:
                logger.warning(f"Error fetching models for provider {provider_key}: {e}")
                build_config["registry_model"]["options"] = []
                build_config["registry_model"]["value"] = ""

        elif field_name == "registry_model":
            provider_label = build_config.get("provider", {}).get("value", "")
            provider_key = PROVIDER_LABEL_TO_KEY.get(provider_label, provider_label)
            if provider_key:
                try:
                    options = _fetch_models_for_provider(provider_key, user_id=current_user_id)
                    build_config["registry_model"]["options"] = options if options else []
                    if options and not build_config["registry_model"].get("value"):
                        build_config["registry_model"]["value"] = options[0]
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.warning(f"Error refreshing registry models: {e}")
                    build_config["registry_model"]["options"] = []

        return build_config

    def build_model(self) -> LanguageModel:  # type: ignore[type-var]
        """Build a MicroserviceChatModel proxy that delegates to the Model microservice."""
        from agentcore.services.model_service_client import MicroserviceChatModel, _get_model_service_settings

        selected = self.registry_model
        if not selected:
            msg = "No model selected. Please select a model from the Registry Model dropdown."
            raise ValueError(msg)

        parts = [p.strip() for p in selected.split("|")]
        if len(parts) < 3:
            msg = f"Invalid registry model format: {selected}. Please refresh the dropdown."
            raise ValueError(msg)

        model_name = parts[1]
        model_id = parts[2]

        # Defence-in-depth: verify per-user RBAC access before building proxy.
        # Skip when the run originates from a PROD+PUBLIC registry agent — the
        # deployer endorsed this model for the public agent at publish time, so
        # any authenticated caller reaching it through the orchestrator (incl.
        # cross-org / cross-dept consumers) is allowed to use it.
        current_user_id = resolve_user_id(self)
        if current_user_id and not is_public_registry_agent_run(self):
            model_dict = fetch_model_by_id_sync(model_id)
            if model_dict and not check_model_access_sync(model_dict, current_user_id):
                raise ValueError("Access denied to selected model due to RBAC scope")

        provider_label = self.provider or ""
        provider_key = PROVIDER_LABEL_TO_KEY.get(provider_label, provider_label).lower()

        temperature = self.temperature if self.temperature not in (None, "") else None
        if temperature is not None:
            temperature = float(temperature)

        max_tokens = self.max_tokens if self.max_tokens not in (None, "") else None
        if max_tokens is not None:
            max_tokens = int(max_tokens)

        service_url, service_api_key = _get_model_service_settings()

        return MicroserviceChatModel(
            service_url=service_url,
            service_api_key=service_api_key,
            provider=provider_key,
            model=model_name,
            registry_model_id=model_id,
            temperature=temperature,
            max_tokens=max_tokens,
            streaming=self.stream,
        )
